title: Language values of a set
description: A file in data/language/set/, such as data/language/set/sta/ja.json. The name of one set as one language prints it, written only where it differs from the English.

set_code.description: The official code of the product, such as STA.

lang.description: The language of these values, such as ja.

name.description: The name of the set as it is printed in this language.

history.description: Records of official corrections to these values. Appended only; past records are never rewritten.
